transitions: video checkpoint pauses lecture and opens an editable TutorScript worksheet
each answer or changed answer produces normal answer history during work; visible correctness feedback is withheld
manual Submit and Continue or work timeout ends work and opens feedback after pending answer writes complete; no batch grading, additional answer records or final-answer snapshot
reconstruct a read-only worksheet from this attempt history, overlay the correct-answer template, and start the separate review countdown
record each actual appearance of feedback as a non-answer exposure, including a new appearance after reload; redraws and retries of the same write add no exposures
review timeout or participant Continue closes feedback and resumes lecture

resume.workDeadline: persist when the worksheet becomes usable; reloading does not extend the maximum work interval
resume.reviewDeadline: persist when work ends and review begins; reloading does not restart the maximum review interval
resume.randomOrder: persist realized question node order within the worksheet attempt and preserve it in feedback
resume.answers: load the latest recorded selection per question from normal history in the relevant learner/lesson/worksheet attempt; earlier changes remain in history; no separate answer snapshot
resume.phase: retain worksheet attempt identity and work/review phase so reload reconstructs the same attempt

unanswered: show a blank learner response, the correct-answer overlay and an incorrect visual indication in feedback; no answer means no answer record and no fabricated model evidence

media.status: Generated synthetic test-only MP4: four labeled concept cards and quiet boundary tones; rounded playback length 20 seconds.
media.provenance: Original title cards and synthesized audio created for local testing; no external footage or learner data.

assignment.status: root uses the implemented server-owned shuffled-block allocator; returning participants retain their assignment

purpose: Explanatory design record only, not runtime configuration or another question authoring system. TutorScript questions and normal stimulus/model references own answer behavior.
feedbackExposure: non-answer history on each actual feedback-page appearance, including reload; retries share the identity of that appearance, ordinary redraws are not appearances; unlike the existing instruction event recorded on Continue
remainingCapabilityWork: Replace synthetic test media with actual lecture media and matching checkpoint times before study delivery
Verify saved-history integration, retries and authorization in the supported Meteor test environment
Verify HTML5/YouTube browser delivery, keyboard/mouse, fullscreen transitions, timed and early completion, and reloads
answerModelPolicy: Save normal model-eligible answers on each selection/change; do not apply live adaptive model updates during the worksheet.
